candidates.title: SPECTRE: Hybrid Ordinary-Parallel Speculative Serving for Resource-Efficient LLM Inference
candidates.reason: underutilized tail-model serviceをremote drafterとして再利用するSGLang実装のmulti-tenant speculative serving。Qwen3-235B-A22B等でautoregressive比最大2.28x。

candidates.title: KernelFlume: Elastic Core-Attention Scaling for Agentic Long-Context Decoding
candidates.reason: projection/FFN weight nodeとweightless attention/KV nodeを分離し、long-context decodeのKV capacityだけをelastic scaleするdecode-centric architecture。agentic long-context servingと階層状態管理に関連。

candidates.title: BlockServe: Block-Grained Continuous Batching for High-Throughput Diffusion LLM Serving
candidates.reason: diffusion LLMのconvergence heterogeneityをblock-grained scheduling、mixed-state execution、compute-aware admissionで処理するcontinuous batching system。Fast-dLLM比1.9-10.6x throughput。
